Multiplying each row in the first matrix by each column in the second, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 & 5 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2\cdot 4+(-1)\cdot (-2) & 2\cdot 5+(-1)\cdot 1 \\ 0\cdot 4+3\cdot (-2) & 0\cdot 5+3\cdot 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}8+2 & 10-1 \\ 0+(-6) & 0+3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}10 & 9 \\ -6 & 3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
